name: Global mean sea level, last 26,000 years
attribution: Sea level after Lambeck et al. 2014
note: Piecewise-linear approximation of the ice-volume equivalent sea level of Lambeck et al. (2014, PNAS 111:15296), built from the amounts and rates the paper states per interval (key results i-xii); the tabulated curve (SI Appendix Table S3) was not used. Expect departures of about 5 m from the published curve. Values are relative to present (pre-industrial) sea level.
